title: 16_impl_context
description: Unified artifact for the implementation loop (Plan -> Code -> Review). Enforces Checklist-Driven Implementation with evidence binding.

specRef.description: A reference to a spec artifact with precise code location binding.

type.description: The artifact type being referenced: functional requirement, API, NFR, invariant, fixture, doc, or code.

id.description: Kebab-case identifier of the referenced artifact.

note.description: Optional contextual note about this reference.

line_range.description: Line range in the source file (e.g., 'L10-L25').

commit_hash.description: Full 40-character git commit hash pinning this reference. Must not be all zeros.

executionStatus.description: Execution outcome: passed, failed, blocked, or partially completed.

evidenceObject.description: Evidence proving that a requirement or check was satisfied.

type.description: The form of evidence: log output, code snippet, screenshot, or external reference.

content.description: The evidence content itself (minimum 20 characters, must contain non-whitespace).

evidence_ref.description: External reference or URI pointing to the evidence source.

path.description: File path where the evidence was captured.

section.description: Section or function name within the file where evidence was found.

allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

review_state.description: Extension tracking the current review state of this implementation context.

outcome.description: The outcome of the review (e.g., approved, rejected, needs-revision).

verified_by.description: Identity of the person or system that verified the review.

execution_context.description: Extension for execution-time overrides and configuration.

command_overrides.description: Map of command names to override values for execution.

additionalProperties.description: Override value for a specific command name.

plan.description: Trinity loop plan (scope, checklist, review requirements, and documentation impact).

status.description: Whether this plan is actively being worked on or deferred.

deferred_reason.description: Explanation for why this plan was deferred.

summary.description: High-level scope summary including what is in and out of scope.

functional_summary.description: Concise summary of the functional changes being implemented.

scope_in.description: Items explicitly included in the scope of this plan.

items.description: An item explicitly included in the plan scope.

scope_out.description: Items explicitly excluded from the scope of this plan.

items.description: An item explicitly excluded from the plan scope.
A file or directory path pattern to modify or create.

target_file_patterns.description: Explicit list of files/directories to modify or create.

docs_impact.description: Documentation impact assessment. Required when any non-doc file is modified.

status.description: Whether documentation updates are required for this change.

rationale.description: Explanation of why documentation is or is not required (minimum 10 characters).

docs_touched.description: List of documentation files that need to be updated.

items.description: A documentation file path that needs updating.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the docs impact status in the registry.

spec_alignment.description: Alignment of the plan with upstream spec requirements and checklist items.

summary.description: Summary of the requirements in this theme.

spec_refs.description: Spec references that belong to this thematic group.

items.description: A spec artifact reference within this thematic group.
A thematic grouping of related spec requirements with optional references.

checklist.description: Checklist items that must be satisfied for spec compliance.

id.description: Unique SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE identifier for this checklist item.

spec_ref.description: Reference to the spec artifact this checklist item traces to.

description.description: Description of what this checklist item requires.

type.description: Classification of the checklist item: behavior, constraint, validation, metadata, performance, logging, docs, or security.

layer.description: Architecture layer this checklist item applies to.

checklist_status.description: Whether this checklist item is actively required or deferred.

linked_test_expectation.description: Test expectation(s) that validate this checklist item. Can be a single string or array of strings.

items.description: A single test expectation string (non-empty).

oneOf.description: An array of test expectation strings.

nfr_refs.description: NFR IDs that this checklist item satisfies.

fixture_ref.description: Fixture ID that validates this checklist item.

milestone_ref.description: Milestone ID from the roadmap that this checklist item belongs to.

implementation.description: Atomic work definition for this specific requirement.

status.description: Current implementation status of this checklist item.

files_touched.description: Files modified or created to implement this checklist item.

items.description: A file path modified or created for this checklist item.

actions.description: Ordered list of implementation actions to satisfy this checklist item.

type.description: The kind of action: create a file, edit a file, run a command, or verify manually.

description.description: Description of what this action does.

target.description: Target file path for file_create or file_edit actions.

command.description: Shell command to execute for run_command actions.

evidence.description: Evidence proving this action was completed successfully.

command_ref.description: Canonical reference for the command in the registry.
Canonical reference for the run_command action's command.

items.description: An atomic implementation action (file create/edit, command, or manual verification).

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the implementation status in the registry.

items.description: A single checklist item binding a spec requirement to its implementation, tests, and evidence.

ambiguities.description: Spec ambiguities discovered during planning that need resolution or tracking.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this ambiguity.

description.description: Description of the ambiguity and its potential impact.

source.description: Where the ambiguity originated: spec, code, plan, mixed sources, or review.

severity.description: Whether this ambiguity blocks progress or can be worked around.

impact.description: List of areas or artifacts affected by this ambiguity.

items.description: An area or artifact affected by this ambiguity.

proposed_assumption.description: Proposed assumption to resolve the ambiguity if no authoritative answer is available.

mitigation.description: Mitigation strategy for non-blocking ambiguities (minimum 10 characters).

status.description: Current resolution status of this ambiguity.

decision.description: The decision made to resolve this ambiguity, if resolved.

resolved.description: Resolution indicator -- a string explanation or boolean flag.

oneOf.description: String explanation of how the ambiguity was resolved.
Boolean flag indicating whether the ambiguity has been resolved.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the ambiguity status in the registry.

items.description: A spec ambiguity discovered during planning with severity, impact, and resolution tracking.

solution.description: High-level solution architecture and risk assessment.

architecture_sketch.description: Textual description of the solution architecture.

sequence_of_concerns.description: Ordered list of concerns to address during implementation.

items.description: A concern to address during implementation, in priority order.

risks.description: Risks identified in the proposed solution.

items.description: A risk identified in the proposed solution.

context.description: Existing codebase context and coding examples relevant to this implementation.

existing_structures.description: Known code or non-code structures. Strings may reference non-code artifacts; objects must cite real code signatures.

oneOf.description: A free-text reference to a non-code or code structure.

signature.description: Function or class signature in the existing codebase.

source_file.description: Relative path to the source file containing this structure.

line_range.description: Line range where the structure is defined (e.g., 'L10-L25').

oneOf.description: A typed code signature referencing a specific function or class in the codebase.

items.description: An existing codebase structure -- either a free-text reference or a typed code signature with file location.

coding_examples.description: Code examples demonstrating patterns to follow in this implementation.

description.description: Explanation of the pattern or technique demonstrated.

items.description: A coding example with title, optional description, and code content.

review_requirements.description: Requirements for reviewing the implementation, including test commands and measurement methods.

guidelines.description: Free-text review guidelines for the reviewer.

test_commands.description: Commands to run to verify the implementation.

command.description: Shell command to execute for verification.

expected_exit_code.description: Expected exit code from the command (default: 0 for success).

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time in seconds before the command is killed.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this test command verifies.

command_ref.description: Canonical reference for the command in the registry.

oneOf.description: A structured test command with expected exit code, timeout, and optional description.

items.description: A test command -- either a simple string or a structured object with expected exit code and timeout.

nfr_measurement_methods.description: Methods for measuring NFR compliance, keyed by NFR ID.

^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: Measurement method for a specific NFR.

command.description: Command to run to measure this NFR.

expected.description: Expected output or threshold for the NFR measurement.

description.description: Description of how this NFR is measured.

command_ref.description: Canonical reference for the measurement command.

timeout_constants.description: Named timeout constants (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE keys, integer millisecond values).

docs.description: Documentation plan: either not applicable with a reason, or planned with required updates.

status.description: Indicates documentation updates are not applicable.

reason.description: Reason why documentation updates are not applicable.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the docs status.

oneOf.description: Documentation status when updates are not applicable.

required_updates.description: List of documentation files that need updating.

path.description: File path of the documentation to update.

update_summary.description: Summary of the changes needed in this document.

items.description: A documentation file that needs updating, with path and change summary.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the docs status.

oneOf.description: Documentation status when updates are planned, with required update details.

security.description: Security plan: either not applicable with a reason, or planned with fixtures and spec mutations.

status.description: Indicates security changes are not applicable.

reason.description: Reason why security changes are not applicable.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the security status.

oneOf.description: Security status when changes are not applicable.

new_fixtures.description: IDs of new security fixtures to create.

spec_mutations.description: Planned mutations to security-related spec artifacts.

ref.description: Trace reference to the spec artifact being mutated.

change.description: Description of the change to make.

reason.description: Reason for the security-related spec mutation.

items.description: A planned security-related mutation to a spec artifact.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the security status.

oneOf.description: Security status when changes are planned, with fixtures and spec mutations.

delivery.description: Delivery observability plan: either not applicable, or planned with dashboards and alerts.

status.description: Indicates delivery observability is not applicable.

reason.description: Reason why delivery observability is not applicable.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the delivery status.

oneOf.description: Delivery observability status when not applicable.

dashboards.description: Monitoring dashboards to create or update.

dashboard_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this dashboard.

items.description: A monitoring dashboard definition with NFR references and optional URL.

alerts.description: Alert rules to create for observability.

alert_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this alert.

items.description: An alert rule definition with severity and NFR binding.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the delivery status.

oneOf.description: Delivery observability status when planned, with dashboards and alerts.

drift.description: Drift detection plan: either not applicable, or planned with scheduled checks.

status.description: Indicates drift detection is not applicable.

reason.description: Reason why drift detection is not applicable.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the drift status.

oneOf.description: Drift detection status when not applicable.

status.description: Indicates drift detection checks are planned.

check_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this drift check.

target.description: The type of artifact being checked for drift.

method.description: Detection method: runtime sampling, log comparison, schema diff, or trace replay.

severity.description: Severity level when drift is detected.

items.description: A scheduled drift detection check targeting a specific artifact type.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the drift status.

oneOf.description: Drift detection status when planned, with scheduled checks.

coverage_status.description: Summary counts of checklist item states.

verified.description: Number of checklist items that have been verified.

deferred.description: Number of checklist items that have been deferred.

pending.description: Number of checklist items still pending.

scope_validation.description: Validation that implementation stayed within declared scope.

in_scope.description: Items confirmed as within scope during implementation.

items.description: An item confirmed as within scope during implementation.

items.description: An item confirmed as out of scope during implementation.

acknowledged.description: Whether scope boundaries have been explicitly acknowledged.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the plan status in the registry.

files_touched.description: All files modified or created during execution.

items.description: A file path modified or created during execution.

status.description: Outcome status of this execution result.

reasoning.description: Explanation of why this outcome occurred.

exit_code.description: Exit code returned by the command.

command_ref.description: Canonical reference for the command in the registry.

items.description: Result from running a single test or verification command during execution.

critical_evidence.description: Summary of critical evidence linking checklist items to test outcomes.

satisfied_checklist_ids.description: Checklist item IDs that have been satisfied with evidence.

passed_test_commands.description: Test commands that passed during execution.

items.description: A test command that passed during execution.

config_validation.description: Validation status of configuration artifacts (dashboards, alerts, drift schedules).

dashboard_links_valid.description: Whether all dashboard links are valid and reachable.

alert_rules_valid.description: Whether all alert rules are syntactically valid.

impact.description: Areas or artifacts affected by this ambiguity.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference for the ambiguity status.

test_results.description: Summary of test results from execution.

items.description: A test result summary object.

ratings.description: Quality ratings across five dimensions (0-5 scale).

metadata_usage.description: Rating of how well metadata and canonical references are used (0-5).

verdict.description: Final review verdict: verified (approved), deferred, or rejected.

next_actions.description: Free-text description of what should happen next after this review.
